results.title: Over 1900 child abuse cases reported in Pakistan in first six months of 2026: Report
results.description: Islamabad, Aug 7 (IANS) As many as 1,914 incidents of child abuse were reported in Pakistan in the first six months of 2026, according to the latest report released by child protection NGO Sahil.
